findings.summary: Source-level network/timeout error diagnostics are dropped in collectOnChainFlow, making collection failures unobservable.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a diagnostic string field to OnChainFlowCollectionResult, populate it from mapSourceErrorToStatus in collectOnChainFlow, and read it in mapCollectionResult.

findings.summary: Redundant and logically impossible checks for deps.sources.length === 1 in runOnChainFlowJob.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the if (deps.sources.length === 1) block, as the logic requires length exactly 2 and validates each source count separately at the bottom.

findings.summary: Unnecessary array map operation on orderedResults using results[idx] when results already matches sortedSources 1:1.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove orderedResults entirely and map outcomes directly from results, as they are pushed in the exact same loop and order as sortedSources.
